resources.string: HyperSpring: genie open/close animation, curtain transitions, bending recents and springy folders for the HyperOS launcher; liquid glass with edge refraction for the control center. Tested on a Redmi 14C with HyperOS 3 and the Mods Center mods (HyperOS Launcher 7.5 and iOS Control Center); also works with the stock ones.
